name: models
description: Architecture models: a proven system's vertical and horizontal shape as data, shipped with the CLI or kept by a project (docs/design/models.md).

MODEL-FORMAT.fix: give the model folder a model.json with name, title, description, layers and slice; layers and domains with unique ids and kinds from the vocabulary; rules of known types; contracts between known ids; decisions as Decision docs (docs: Models)

PIPELINE-ORDER.fix: wire the stages in the model's order, or point model.wiring in the profile at the file and the pattern that name them (docs: Models)

PROVIDER-CONTRACT.fix: declare each field the model's slice asks under the module's slice in the profile (docs: Models)

LONG-RUNNING.fix: answer the flagged operation in one of the model's shapes, with its link and retry headers named in model.operations, and give a delete its no-content answer (docs: Models)

EVENT-COVERAGE.fix: name the events each write operation emits under model.events.marker, each defined in the model.events.files (docs: Models)

commands.name: models
commands.does: list the architecture models this project can apply; doc writes a project model's Model doc, apply takes one on, gaps lists what the modules miss of it

messages.modelName: model {{model}} is named {{name}} inside: the folder name is its name
messages.modelItemId: model {{model}}: an item of {{key}} has no id
messages.modelKind: model {{model}}: {{id}} has kind {{kind}}, not one of {{kinds}}
messages.modelRule: model {{model}}: rule type {{type}} is not one of {{types}}
messages.modelContract: model {{model}}: a contract's {{end}} is {{id}}, which is no layer, domain or the slice
messages.modelDecision: model {{model}}: decisions/{{file}} is not a Decision doc
messages.modelNone: no models: the plugin ships none yet, and the project keeps its own in {{dir}}/<name>/
messages.modelsUsage: usage: aidlc models, or aidlc models doc <name>, apply <name> or gaps
messages.modelUnknown: no project model {{name}} in {{dir}}: aidlc models lists them
messages.modelDocWrote: wrote {{path}} from {{file}}: ask the owner to approve it (aidlc approve {{path}})
messages.stageNoWiring: model {{model}}: the profile's model.wiring names no file and pattern for the stage order
messages.stageNoFile: model {{model}}: {{file}}, the wiring model.wiring names, does not exist
messages.stageMissing: model {{model}}: the wiring names no {{stage}} stage
messages.stageOrder: model {{model}}: the stages come as {{found}}, not in the model's order {{stages}}
messages.sliceMissing: model {{model}}: module {{module}} ({{kind}}) declares no {{fields}} under slice
messages.lroNoNames: model {{model}}: model.operations in the profile names no {{roles}} header
messages.lroShape: model {{model}}: {{method}} {{path}} is flagged long-running but answers none of {{shapes}}
messages.lroDelete: model {{model}}: DELETE {{path}} declares no {{code}} answer for an absent resource
messages.eventsNoFiles: model {{model}}: model.events in the profile names no events files
messages.eventsUnknown: model {{model}}: {{method}} {{path}} emits {{event}}, which no events file defines
messages.idempotentMissing: {{unit}} has a write AC but none that repeats it and finds status and state unchanged
messages.modelNotApplicable: no model {{name}} in the format: aidlc models lists them, aidlc check says what breaks one
messages.applySystem: wrote {{path}}: its building blocks are the model's; fill the other sections with the owner
messages.applyDecision: wrote {{path}}, a proposal for the owner to approve (one-way doors one at a time)
messages.applyIncrements: increments along {{name}}'s layers, for the intent's # Increments:
messages.incSkeleton: Walking skeleton: one request through {{layers}}, end to end on the target
messages.gapsNoModel: the profile chooses no model: aidlc models apply <name>, or model.name in {{file}}
messages.gapsHead: model {{name}}: {{played}} of {{total}} items played by modules (modules[].layer)
messages.gapsMissing: missing, for the brownfield intent's # Increments:

steps.research: a Research digest under research/ for each name in research:
steps.model: a current Model doc for model: (aidlc models doc <name>), its model in the format

MODEL-SOURCE.fix: give each layer, domain and rule of the model sources: ids of the sources of the research: digests the intent names (docs: Models)

IDEMPOTENCY-AC.fix: add an AC that repeating the write leaves its status and state unchanged (docs: Models)

DATA-PARTITION.fix: write each owned table as `table` (partition: <key>, class: <class>), with a class the model lists (docs: Models)
